summary.text: Ben Davis is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 6A who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A pastor who lives in Merrifield, he faces Democrat Samuel Patrick Grigsby in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Ben Davis lives in Merrifield, Minnesota, and his career experience includes working as a pastor.
Davis defeated Richard Blake in the 2022 general election for District 6A and took office on January 3, 2023, and he defeated Earl Butenhoff in 2024.

In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Elections Finance and Policy, Labor, Industry, Veterans and Military Affairs Finance and Policy, and State Government Finance and Policy committees, with co-vice chair roles on the State Government committees.
